name: Ashes of Love
description: Jin Mi is the daughter of a flower deity who is fed a pill that prevents her from feeling or expressing romantic love. She gets tangled in a love triangle with Heavenly Prince Xu Feng and the ambitious Night Deity Run Yu.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Xufeng, the Heavenly Emperor's second son, finds his nirvana interrupted. He falls into the Floral World, where Jinmi saves him.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Xufeng takes Jinmi away from the Water Mirror and brings her to the Heavenly Realm. Along the way, they run across rebels.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Disguised as a man, Jinmi wanders through the Heavenly Realm and makes some new friends, including a matchmaker and Runyu, the eldest prince.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: After becoming Xufeng's attendant, Jinmi is punished for her poor training. Nevertheless, she helps Xufeng with conscription.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: To thank Xufeng for giving her rice dumplings, Jinmi conjures a phoenix flower tree. At the same time, the truth about her identity is exposed.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Xufeng asks the Heavenly Emperor to keep Qiongqi in the Demon Realm. Jinmi secretly journeys to the Demon Realm with Xufeng.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Liuying, the princess of the Demon Realm, joins the fight against Qiongqi as everyone works together to battle the beast.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Qiongqi attacks Xufeng while he protects Jinmi. Now, in return, she must do everything in her power to save the prince.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Xufeng confesses his love for Jinmi in front of the Great Floral Fairy. In response, Jinmi passes out.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Runyu transports Jinmi from the Water Mirror. The Heavenly Empress orders Qiyuan to find information on Jinmi, then decides to meet her in person.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Jinmi goes to intoxicating new lengths to save Puchi, but on the brink of a big moment, Xufeng suddenly sobers up.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jinmi crashes the Heavenly Empress' birthday party — which has dire consequences.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Jinmi finds herself in grave danger. Later, the Water Immortal asks the sprite about her relationship with Zifen.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Hu tells the Water Deity about the death of the Flower Goddess. Jinmi's true identity is revealed.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The Heavenly Emperor arranges the marriage of Runyu and Jinmi. In the meantime, a matchmaker encourages Xufeng to pursue true love.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Kuanglu urges Jinmi not to get too close to Xufeng while the two princes attempt to catch Puchi.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The Wind Immortal fills in Jinmi about her history with the Flower Goddess. Later, Jinmi undertakes a task.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Feigning illness, Xufeng gets a kiss. In the Human Realm, Jinmi is forced to undergo trials.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Xufeng and Suihe jump into the Human Realm along with Jinmi, who is fortunately saved after being abandoned.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Jinmi steals millennium snow ginseng to save Xufeng, but a king has other deadly plans in store for the prince.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: A frustrated Runyu discovers that Xufeng and Jinmi are becoming close. A romantic clinch helps the prince evade violent soldiers.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Threatened with death, Xufeng departs without a word. Meanwhile, Jinmi is asked to go to the palace.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Sent to cure Xufeng, Jinmi gets a visit from Runyu in the Human Realm. Liuying compares Qiyuan to her ex.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Lovesickness could be the diagnosis for Xufeng. In the meantime, Runyu must try to save Jinmi from the arrow.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Qiyuan appears to save Liuying when she jumps off a cliff. With Jinmi's help, Xufeng pretends to be sick in front of Suihe.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Jinmi makes a life-changing decision, but then circumstance takes it out of her hands. Runyu must now erase some critical memories.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: The Heavenly Empress orders Qiyuan to recover the lost arrow. Elsewhere, Jinmi reveals the truth about Xufeng.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Xufeng makes lanterns for Jinmi, but she still wants to leave the palace. Yanyou and the matchmaker give Suihe a spell to break her engagement with Xufeng.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Xufeng comes up with many ways to make Jinmi happy. Runyu sees his mother, Suli, but when he recovers his memory, he decides to cut ties with her.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Xufeng gives Jinmi a tortoise. Runyu tells Kuanglu about his childhood and suddenly realizes that his mother never abandons him.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Jinmi knows that the end is approaching — and finally expresses her love. The Heavenly Empress arrives with deadly intentions.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: The Heavenly Empress orders Qiyuan to recapture the arrow and kill Jinmi. Qianghuo confesses that she poisoned the tea.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Suihe gives Qiyuan a deadly directive, but will the arrow find its mark? At the end, emotions overwhelm a deity.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Xufeng drinks deeply to end his trials, and two lovers make their return. The Heavenly Empress asks the Emperor to punish those who live in Dongting.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Runyu comes to a startling realization about his father. Meanwhile, Jinmi considers canceling her engagement.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Jinmi tells Xufeng that she wants to marry him. In the meantime, Runyu tells Xufeng not to care too much about his fiancée.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: The matchmaker has a very happy birthday. Runyu repairs the broken Yundan in Jinmi's body and changes the course of events.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Jinmi gives up her plans, then realizes that the Heavenly Empress hurt her mother and decides to fight the deity.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: The Heavenly Empress' crime emerges, and Xufeng is injured. Muci leaves Liuying because he doesn't want to become a burden.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Xufeng suffers the consequences because he refuses to marry Suihe. Elsewhere, Runyu prepares for revenge.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Suihe commands Qiyuan to make another arrow. They encounter Jinmi, and Suihe changes course. Xufeng puts a stop to a plan.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Suihe takes action. After two shocking deaths, Xufeng finds himself the focus as the prime suspect. Can Jinmi follow through?

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Jinmi begins to investigate the cause of death. Liuying goes to the Heavenly Realm in search of help for her father.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Xufeng must examine the circumstances of a god's death. In the following three years, Runyu plots to usurp the throne on his wedding day.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Xufeng sets out to suppress the rebellion on Runyu's wedding day. In the end, Jinmi makes a deadly mistake.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Jinmi spits out the Yundan and falls into a deep sleep for half a year. Runyu becomes the new Heavenly Emperor and breaks the news to Tuyao.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Jinmi learns of the Yundan's existence, then discovers that Xufeng didn't wrong her.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Jinmi comes across information about a strand of Xufeng's soul. Suihe hopes to save the prince, but Runyu has his own dark plans.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Liuying decides to attack the Heavenly Realm. Meanwhile, Jinmi, the matchmaker and Yanyou begin their search for a crucial cure.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Jinmi uses all the colors in her eyes to get the medicine — and puts herself in extreme danger. Can Runyu come to her rescue?

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Jinmi uses the Golden Dan to revive Xufeng, but Suihe lies and says that she saved him. Xufeng doesn't know which way to turn.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Xufeng prays at his parents' tomb but is surrounded by Runyu's troops. Jinmi begs Runyu to release Xufeng, yet mercy seems out of reach.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Xufeng becomes the new Demon Lord and teams up with Suihe. Runyu puts Jinmi under house confinement, but the matchmaker comes to her aid.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Jinmi visits Xufeng as he sleeps, and he kisses her but calls her by another name. A saddened Jinmi finds Yanyou severely hurt.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Jinmi uncovers a cure and learns the truth about her father. Now she must destroy her nemesis — though the one she loves stands in her way.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Jinmi tries to apologize, but it looks like she's run out of second chances. Tears fall as she makes a confession.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Once again, Muci must make an arrow, which he uses to kill a king. A death follows a wedding, and Jinmi finally agrees to marry Runyu.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Xufeng begins to view Suihe with doubt. Later, Suihe argues with Runyu, and Jinmi hears the truth.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Runyu locks up Jinmi, but she escapes to the Floral Realm with Yanyou's help. Jinmi obtains an herb to help Xufeng then travels to the Demon Realm.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Xufeng and Suihe's wedding day arrives. But where is the bride — and will truth prevail?

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Runyu sends troops to the Demon Realm to retrieve Jinmi. But the deity will go to any length to stop the war.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Hope remains alive for Xufeng: He passes the title of the Demon Lord to Liuying and searches for Jinmi's soul. A crucial choice awaits.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Xufeng vows to find Jinmi one way or another. Will these lovers ever have their happily ever after?
